verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs confirm that developers can create fine-grained personal access tokens and grant each one a specific set of permissions that define which API resources it can access. The docs also add an `X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions` response header that shows which permissions an endpoint requires. The evidence does not show the other two elements of the story: restricting a token to specific repositories, or setting an expiry date. Missing for 10: documented per-repository scoping of tokens, documented expiry configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
